claim_being_audited: That the model should be certified now on the current record, based on aggregate readiness evidence plus a draft monitoring/rollback concept, with at most limited caveat.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows no material weakness remains, or shows an approved mitigation satisfying all policy elements.
Use suspicious when the packet has some support for the action direction but a required policy predicate or support link is missing.
Treat aggregate readiness, public guidance, and draft monitoring as supportive context, not as substitutes for the policy-required certification predicates.
Maintain the concern unless the missing approval/disclosure/remediation evidence is supplied from admissible sources.
evidence_requests: Approved risk-acceptance or mitigation record covering the fraud dispute review weakness, with owner, threshold, review date, rollback criterion, and approval status.
Final model-card or disclosure artifact explicitly addressing whether the fraud dispute review weakness is a material limitation for the named launch use case.
Evidence that the below-target fraud dispute review slice has been remediated to threshold, or a documented materiality determination showing it is not material under policy.
specific_concerns: The policy requires either no remaining material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion; the admissible record shows neither.
The fraud dispute review slice remains below target for a named launch use case, so the material-limitation predicate is unresolved.
The cited mitigation is only a draft runbook and explicitly leaves accountable owner and alert threshold as TBD.
The model-card draft states there are no known material limitations despite reviewer concern that this issue should be disclosed, creating a disclosure-completeness problem.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness generally, but do not by themselves satisfy the certification-without-caveat policy threshold.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that current evidence supports certification without material caveat.
Any claim that draft monitoring and future rollback planning remove the present disclosure requirement.
Any claim that the unresolved fraud dispute review weakness is already resolved or adequately covered by approved risk acceptance.
